```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
```

Figure 2 on the REML curves of the 71 trajectories (`resources/LoD/`): the per-trajectory
statistics by gene (maximal VAF, mean speed, mean acceleration, age at LoD/2 and age at 2% VAF), the gene-level tests and
the correlation with the fitness effects of Fabre et al. 2022, the correlation heatmap of the statistics, the scheme of
the two modes of growth, and the final consensus DTW clusters (`03_consensus_clusters.Rmd`). Also the
supplementary figures of the statistics by cluster (Figure S7) and of the individuals with several trajectories by cluster
(Figure S8). The sign
of the mean speed and of the mean acceleration of each trajectory is checked against the 95% interval from the posterior
of the spline coefficients.

```{r libraries}
source("R/paper_functions.R")
library(gratia)

calls <- load_calls()
pred  <- load_pred()
sum_  <- load_sum()
ages  <- load_ages()
cl    <- load_final_clusters()
fabre <- load_fabre()
k_cl  <- n_distinct(cl$cluster)
sum_c <- sum_ %>% inner_join(cl %>% select(traj_id, cluster), by = "traj_id")
stopifnot(nrow(sum_c) == 71)
n_draws <- 1000
```

# 1. Uncertainty of the per-trajectory statistics: the posterior of the spline

```{r reml-ci}
reml_draws <- calls %>% group_split(traj_id) %>% map_dfr(function(obs) {
  obs <- arrange(obs, Age)
  f <- fit_traj(obs$Age, obs$AF, spec_main)
  ag <- curve_ages(obs$Age, f$predict, FALSE)
  n <- length(ag)
  fs <- fitted_samples(f$model, n = n_draws, data = data.frame(Age = c(ag, ag + step)), seed = 1) %>% arrange(.draw, .row)
  m <- matrix(fs$.fitted, nrow = 2 * n)
  speed <- (m[(n + 1):(2 * n), , drop = FALSE] - m[1:n, , drop = FALSE]) / step
  acc <- rbind(0, apply(speed, 2, diff)) / step
  tibble(traj_id = obs$traj_id[1], draw = seq_len(ncol(m)), mean_VAF_speed = colMeans(speed), mean_VAF_acceleration = colMeans(acc))
})
reml_ci <- reml_draws %>% group_by(traj_id) %>%
  summarise(across(c(mean_VAF_speed, mean_VAF_acceleration), list(lo = ~ quantile(.x, 0.025), hi = ~ quantile(.x, 0.975))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(sum_ %>% select(traj_id, SHCS_ID_new, mean_VAF_speed, mean_VAF_acceleration), by = "traj_id") %>%
  mutate(speed_sign_robust = mean_VAF_speed_lo > 0 | mean_VAF_speed_hi < 0, acc_sign_robust = mean_VAF_acceleration_lo > 0 | mean_VAF_acceleration_hi < 0)
write_res(reml_ci, "fig2_reml_posterior_ci.txt")
reml_ci %>% summarise(trajectories = n(), `mean speed > 0` = sum(mean_VAF_speed > 0), `mean speed > 0, interval excludes 0` = sum(mean_VAF_speed > 0 & speed_sign_robust),
                      `mean speed < 0, interval excludes 0` = sum(mean_VAF_speed < 0 & speed_sign_robust),
                      `mean acceleration: interval excludes 0` = sum(acc_sign_robust)) %>% knitr::kable()
```

# 2. Figure 2a-e: dynamics by gene

```{r fig2abcde, fig.width=18, fig.height=4.5}
p2a <- box_by_gene(sum_, "max_VAF", "VAF (max)", chip_vaf)
p2b <- box_by_gene(sum_, "mean_VAF_speed", "VAF speed (mean)", 0)
p2c <- box_by_gene(sum_, "mean_VAF_acceleration", "VAF acceleration (mean)", 0)
p2d <- box_by_gene(sum_, "Age_LoD2", "Age at LoD/2", median(sum_$Age_LoD2, na.rm = TRUE))
p2e <- box_by_gene(sum_, "Age_0.02", "Age at 2% VAF", median(sum_$Age_0.02, na.rm = TRUE))
panels <- list(a = p2a, b = p2b, c = p2c, d = p2d, e = p2e)
names_ <- c(a = "max_VAF", b = "mean_speed", c = "mean_acceleration", d = "age_LoD2", e = "age_2pct")
for (nm in names(panels)) save_panel(panels[[nm]], 2, paste0("Fig2", nm, "_", names_[[nm]], "_by_gene"), 4, 4.5)
p_2ae <- (p2a | p2b | p2c | p2d | p2e) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & tag_theme
p_2ae
```

## 2.1 Gene-level statistics

```{r gene-stats}
g5 <- sum_ %>% filter(Gene.refGene %in% main_genes) %>% mutate(group = ifelse(Gene.refGene %in% c("DNMT3A", "TP53"), "DNMT3A, TP53", "TET2, ASXL1, PPM1D"))
gene_tab <- sum_ %>% group_by(Gene = Gene.refGene) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), `mean speed, gene mean` = mean(mean_VAF_speed), `mean speed, median` = median(mean_VAF_speed),
            `max VAF, median` = median(max_VAF), `mean acceleration, median` = median(mean_VAF_acceleration),
            `age at LoD/2, median` = median(Age_LoD2, na.rm = TRUE), `age at 2%, median` = median(Age_0.02, na.rm = TRUE),
            `growing (mean speed > 0)` = sum(mean_VAF_speed > eps_group), `shrinking` = sum(mean_VAF_speed < -eps_group),
            `accelerating (mean acc > 0)` = sum(mean_VAF_acceleration > eps_group), .groups = "drop")
knitr::kable(gene_tab, digits = 4)
fc <- fabre_cor(sum_, fabre)
first_age <- calls %>% group_by(traj_id) %>% summarise(a = min(Age), .groups = "drop")
tests <- tibble(
  test = c("Mann-Whitney, DNMT3A + TP53 vs TET2 + ASXL1 + PPM1D (mean speed)", "Kruskal-Wallis across the 5 genes (mean speed)",
           "Kruskal-Wallis across the 5 genes (mean acceleration)", "Kruskal-Wallis across the 5 genes (age at LoD/2)", "Kruskal-Wallis across the 5 genes (age at 2% VAF)",
           "Pearson r, gene mean speed vs Fabre gene effect (one-sided)", "Fabre correlation p",
           "trajectories with mean speed > 0", "trajectories with mean acceleration > 0",
           "trajectories with mean speed > 0 and a 95% posterior interval excluding 0", "trajectories with mean speed < 0 and a 95% posterior interval excluding 0",
           "median age at LoD/2 (IQR)", "median age at 2% VAF (IQR)", "trajectories with an estimated age at LoD/2", "trajectories with an estimated age at 2%",
           "trajectories that crossed 2% during follow-up", "trajectories not detected at the first timepoint"),
  value = c(fmt_p(wilcox.test(mean_VAF_speed ~ group, data = g5, exact = FALSE)$p.value),
            fmt_p(kruskal.test(mean_VAF_speed ~ Gene.refGene, data = g5)$p.value),
            fmt_p(kruskal.test(mean_VAF_acceleration ~ Gene.refGene, data = g5)$p.value),
            fmt_p(kruskal.test(Age_LoD2 ~ Gene.refGene, data = g5)$p.value),
            fmt_p(kruskal.test(Age_0.02 ~ Gene.refGene, data = g5)$p.value),
            sprintf("%.2f", fc$r), fmt_p(fc$p),
            sum(sum_$mean_VAF_speed > eps_group), sum(sum_$mean_VAF_acceleration > eps_group),
            sum(reml_ci$mean_VAF_speed > 0 & reml_ci$speed_sign_robust), sum(reml_ci$mean_VAF_speed < 0 & reml_ci$speed_sign_robust),
            iqr_txt(sum_$Age_LoD2), iqr_txt(sum_$Age_0.02), sum(!is.na(sum_$Age_LoD2)), sum(!is.na(sum_$Age_0.02)),
            sum(!is.na(sum_$Age_0.02) & sum_$Age_0.02 > first_age$a[match(sum_$traj_id, first_age$traj_id)] + 0.25),
            sum((calls %>% group_by(traj_id) %>% arrange(Age) %>% summarise(f = first(source) == "imputed"))$f)))
knitr::kable(tests)
write_res(gene_tab, "fig2_gene_table.txt"); write_res(tests, "fig2_tests.txt")
knitr::kable(fc$genes, digits = 4, caption = "Gene means against the Fabre et al. gene effects")
```

# 3. Figure 2f-g: correlations of the statistics and the two modes of growth

```{r fig2f, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
col_order <- c("N_CHIP_more1", "mean_VAF", "sd_VAF", "min_VAF", "max_VAF", "mean_VAF_speed", "max_VAF_speed", "mean_VAF_acceleration",
               "mean_Age", "min_Age", "max_Age", "Time", "Age_LoD2", "Age_0.02")
hm <- corr_heatmap(sum_ %>% select(all_of(col_order)), col_order, stat_labels, size = 16)
save_panel(hm, 2, "Fig2f_statistics_heatmap", 8, 7)
hm
rc <- Hmisc::rcorr(as.matrix(sum_[, col_order]), type = "spearman")
cor_long <- as.data.frame(rc$r) %>% rownames_to_column("stat1") %>% pivot_longer(-stat1, names_to = "stat2", values_to = "rho") %>%
  mutate(p = as.vector(rc$P)) %>% filter(match(stat1, col_order) > match(stat2, col_order))
write_res(cor_long, "fig2f_correlations.txt")
cor_long %>% filter(stat1 %in% c("Age_LoD2", "Age_0.02", "mean_VAF_acceleration", "mean_VAF_speed") | stat2 %in% c("Age_LoD2", "Age_0.02", "mean_VAF_acceleration", "mean_VAF_speed")) %>%
  mutate(rho = round(rho, 2), p = signif(p, 2)) %>% knitr::kable()
```

```{r fig2g, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
# the drawn scheme of the two modes of growth (assets/Fig2g_two_modes_scheme.png)
scheme_png <- png::readPNG("assets/Fig2g_two_modes_scheme.png")
p_2g <- wrap_elements(full = grid::rasterGrob(scheme_png, interpolate = TRUE))
p_2g
```

```{r fig2hij, fig.width=14, fig.height=4.5}
p2h <- cluster_curves_plot(pred, cl) + labs(y = "VAF")
p2i <- cluster_box(sum_c, "mean_VAF_speed", "VAF speed (mean)", clusters = cl) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12))
p2j <- cluster_genes_plot(cl, calls %>% distinct(traj_id, Gene = Gene.refGene)) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12))
save_panel(p2h, 2, "Fig2h_clusters_curves", 3 * k_cl + 1, 4.5); save_panel(p2i, 2, "Fig2i_speed_by_cluster", 4, 4.5); save_panel(p2j, 2, "Fig2j_genes_by_cluster", 4, 4.5)
p_2hij <- (p2h | p2i | p2j) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.1 * k_cl, 1, 1)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("h", "i", "j"))) & tag_theme
p_2hij
```

## 4.1 Cluster description

```{r cluster-table}
first_tp <- calls %>% group_by(traj_id) %>% arrange(Age) %>% summarise(first_age = first(Age), first_source = first(source), first_AF = first(AF), .groups = "drop")
sum_c <- sum_c %>% left_join(first_tp, by = "traj_id") %>%
  mutate(crossed_2pct_during_fup = !is.na(Age_0.02) & Age_0.02 > first_age + 0.25, first_not_detected = first_source == "imputed",
         cluster_label = cluster_factor(cluster, cl))
cl_stats <- c(mean_VAF = "VAF (mean)", max_VAF = "VAF (max)", mean_VAF_speed = "VAF speed (mean)", max_VAF_speed = "VAF speed (max)",
              mean_VAF_acceleration = "VAF acceleration (mean)", mean_Age = "Age (mean)", Time = "Follow-up time, years",
              Age_LoD2 = "Age at LoD/2", Age_0.02 = "Age at 2% VAF")
test_k <- function(x, g) kruskal.test(x ~ g)$p.value   # Kruskal-Wallis, as printed in Figure S7 (also when one cluster has no value)
cl_tab <- map_dfr(names(cl_stats), function(s) {
  d <- sum_c %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[s]]))
  med <- d %>% group_by(cluster_label) %>% summarise(n = n(), median = median(.data[[s]]), .groups = "drop")
  tibble(statistic = cl_stats[[s]], !!!setNames(as.list(sprintf("%s (n = %d)", signif(med$median, 3), med$n)), as.character(med$cluster_label)), p = test_k(d[[s]], d$cluster_label))
})
t2 <- table(sum_c$crossed_2pct_during_fup, sum_c$cluster_label)
tg <- table(group_genes(sum_c$Gene.refGene), sum_c$cluster_label)
share_row <- function(name, v) {
  sh <- sum_c %>% group_by(cluster_label) %>% summarise(x = n_pct(.data[[v]]), .groups = "drop")
  tibble(statistic = name, !!!setNames(as.list(sh$x), as.character(sh$cluster_label)), p = fisher.test(table(sum_c[[v]], sum_c$cluster_label))$p.value)
}
set.seed(2026)   # the Fisher test of the genes uses a simulated p value
cl_tab <- bind_rows(cl_tab, share_row("crossed 2% VAF during follow-up, n (%)", "crossed_2pct_during_fup"), share_row("not detected at the first timepoint, n (%)", "first_not_detected"),
                    tibble(statistic = "genes (Fisher)", p = fisher.test(tg, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 10000)$p.value))
knitr::kable(cl_tab %>% mutate(p = signif(p, 2)))
write_res(cl_tab, "fig2_cluster_statistics.txt")
knitr::kable(tg, caption = "Genes by cluster")
```

# 5. Figure S7: statistics by cluster

```{r figS-clusters, fig.width=13, fig.height=7}
hl <- c(mean_VAF = chip_vaf, max_VAF = chip_vaf, mean_VAF_speed = 0, max_VAF_speed = 0, mean_VAF_acceleration = 0)
p_s2 <- wrap_plots(imap(cl_stats, ~ cluster_box(sum_c, .y, .x, if (.y %in% names(hl)) hl[[.y]] else NULL, size = 13, clusters = cl) +
                          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10))), ncol = 5) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & tag_theme
save_supp(p_s2, "FigS7_clusters_statistics", 13, 7)
p_s2
```

# 6. Figure S8: individuals with several trajectories, by cluster

```{r figS-cooccurring-clusters, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
multi_ids <- calls %>% filter(N_CHIP > 1) %>% distinct(SHCS_ID_new) %>% mutate(num = as.integer(sub("SHCS_", "", SHCS_ID_new))) %>% arrange(num) %>% pull(SHCS_ID_new)
pm <- pred %>% inner_join(cl %>% select(traj_id, cluster), by = "traj_id") %>% filter(SHCS_ID_new %in% multi_ids) %>%
  mutate(SHCS_ID_new = factor(SHCS_ID_new, levels = multi_ids), cluster = cluster_factor(cluster, cl))
om <- calls %>% filter(SHCS_ID_new %in% multi_ids) %>% inner_join(cl %>% select(traj_id, cluster), by = "traj_id") %>%
  mutate(SHCS_ID_new = factor(SHCS_ID_new, levels = multi_ids), cluster = cluster_factor(cluster, cl))
cols_k <- setNames(cluster_colors_k[seq_len(k_cl)], levels(pm$cluster))
p_s3 <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = pm, aes(x = Age, y = VAF, colour = cluster, group = traj_id), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = om, aes(x = Age, y = AF, colour = cluster), size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols_k, name = "Cluster") +
  facet_wrap(~SHCS_ID_new, nrow = 4, ncol = 4, scales = "free") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = chip_vaf, linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) + theme(strip.background = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(y = "VAF (clone size)")
save_supp(p_s3, "FigS8_cooccurring_by_cluster", 11, 8)
p_s3
```
